svg.title: Change impact: WP-P-04
svg.desc: Change impact of WP-P-04 Documentation management, dated 2026-11-12: 1 work products depend on it in the process model; 1 have no version dated after it, 0 have been updated since, 0 have no dated version.
svg.text: Every work product that depends on the change in the process model (WP-P-11), coloured by whether it has a version dated after the change.
What changed is quoted on this page, below the picture.
1 no version dated after the change: worth a look
Small number on a chip: steps from the change.
Dashed box: nothing in it depends on the change.
Depending on a change is a prompt to look, not proof of an impact: the impact analysis (WP-M-12) and its records decide what a change actually affects. Status is not acceptance.

g.text: Terms: WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
